verdict.rationale: Exa documents custom vertical indexes for people, companies, and research publications, plus a code search tool via MCP. Domain and path-prefix filters (includeDomains/excludeDomains) and published-date filters can approximate vertical scoping. However, the evidence never shows a named category filter or dedicated endpoints for news, images, or finance. One hands-on report says GitHub repo search found about 30% of what was asked. Missing for 10: an explicit category filter parameter, dedicated news/image/finance verticals or endpoints, and documentation of how to select a vertical index in a query.
